name: material-code-review-marketplace
description: Evidence-gated material review of concrete Git change scopes for AI coding agents.

plugins.name: material-code-review
plugins.description: Review concrete Git changes (uncommitted, branch/diff, ref range, or PR) for material defects, regressions, behavior-protecting test gaps, or merge readiness, with evidence-gated repair. Implicit use excludes document/generated-output review, output diagnosis, general skill/plugin/repository analysis, architecture exploration, and planning-only work.
